```c
// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul baseline (41x512x512).
void solution(void) {
  // 1. Hoist invariant configurations outside all loops
  gemmini_flush(0);
  gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);

  int DIM_SIZE = 16;
  int dim_I = (REAL_M + DIM_SIZE - 1) / DIM_SIZE;
  int dim_J = (REAL_N + DIM_SIZE - 1) / DIM_SIZE;
  int dim_K = MATMUL_K / DIM_SIZE;

  // Max tiles allowed by ACC (tiles_I * tiles_J <= 16) and SPAD.
  // We use max tiles_I = 3 (48 rows), tiles_J = 4 (64 cols)
  for (int i0 = 0; i0 < dim_I; i0 += 3) {
    int tiles_I = dim_I - i0;
    if (tiles_I > 3) tiles_I = 3;
    int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * DIM_SIZE;
    if (mrows > tiles_I * DIM_SIZE) mrows = tiles_I * DIM_SIZE;

    // Load A scales for this block, packed compactly
    int groups = MATMUL_K / 32;
    uint8_t A_s[32 * 48]; // max 32 groups, 48 rows
    memset(A_s, 0, sizeof(A_s));
    for (int g = 0; g < groups; g++) {
      for (int i = 0; i < mrows; i++) {
        A_s[g * (tiles_I * DIM_SIZE) + i] = A_scales_row[g][i0 * DIM_SIZE + i];
      }
    }
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)A_s, groups * (tiles_I * DIM_SIZE), 0);

    // MVIN A matrix into scratchpad
    uint32_t a_base = 0;
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(uint8_t));
    for (int i = 0; i < tiles_I; i++) {
      int r_rows = mrows - i * DIM_SIZE;
      if (r_rows > DIM_SIZE) r_rows = DIM_SIZE;
      if (r_rows <= 0) continue;
      for (int k = 0; k < dim_K; k++) {
        gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((uint8_t*)A_in) + ((i0 + i) * DIM_SIZE) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM_SIZE),
                              a_base + (i * dim_K + k) * DIM_SIZE, DIM_SIZE, r_rows);
      }
    }

    for (int j0 = 0; j0 < dim_J; j0 += 4) {
      int tiles_J = dim_J - j0;
      if (tiles_J > 4) tiles_J = 4;
      int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * DIM_SIZE;
      if (ncols > tiles_J * DIM_SIZE) ncols = tiles_J * DIM_SIZE;

      uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - dim_K * tiles_J * DIM_SIZE;

      // Load B scales for this block, packed compactly
      uint8_t B_s[32 * 64]; // max 32 groups, 64 cols
      memset(B_s, 0, sizeof(B_s));
      for (int g = 0; g < groups; g++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < ncols; j++) {
          B_s[g * (tiles_J * DIM_SIZE) + j] = B_scales_col[g][j0 * DIM_SIZE + j];
        }
      }
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)B_s, groups * (tiles_J * DIM_SIZE), 1);

      // MVIN B matrix into scratchpad
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(uint8_t));
      for (int j = 0; j < tiles_J; j++) {
        int c_cols = ncols - j * DIM_SIZE;
        if (c_cols > DIM_SIZE) c_cols = DIM_SIZE;
        if (c_cols <= 0) continue;
        for (int k = 0; k < dim_K; k++) {
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((uint8_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM_SIZE) * MATMUL_N + (j0 + j) * DIM_SIZE),
                                b_base + (j * dim_K + k) * DIM_SIZE, c_cols, DIM_SIZE);
        }
      }

      // Prepare local requantizer scale factors
      uint8_t local_sf[48 * 4]; 
      memset(local_sf, 0, sizeof(local_sf));
      for (int i = 0; i < mrows; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < tiles_J; j++) {
          local_sf[i * tiles_J + j] = ((uint8_t*)scale_factors)[(i0 * DIM_SIZE + i) * (MATMUL_N / DIM_SIZE) + (j0 + j)];
        }
      }

      // Configure requantization and launch fused loop
      gemmini_config_st(MATMUL_N * sizeof(uint16_t));
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)local_sf, tiles_I, tiles_J, dim_K, 0, 0, 1);
      
      int SPAD_DEST = 0;
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles_I, tiles_J, dim_K, 
                           0, 0, 0, 
                           a_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0, SPAD_DEST, 
                           false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

      // Drain BF16 results from mx_smem into exactly the correct strided output positions
      for (int r = 0; r < mrows; r++) {
        gemmini_mx_read_smem((void*)(((uint16_t*)C_hw) + (i0 * DIM_SIZE + r) * MATMUL_N + j0 * DIM_SIZE),
                             SPAD_DEST * 16 + r * (tiles_J * DIM_SIZE), ncols);
      }
      gemmini_fence();
    }
  }
}
```
